end_state.definition: Autonomous, accountable, affordable public-interest operation that repeatedly produces independently verified external outcomes across regions without depending on recruited external contributors or constant owner direction.

requirements: All reported outcomes have public primary-source before/after evidence and attribution caveats
At least two separate reviewers or methods on consequential claims; qualified domain review when required
One canonical task/lease owner; bounded and observable execution; demonstrable privacy and revocation
No dependency on volunteer registration to keep the core outcome pipeline active

end_state.note: This is the target state, not current observed performance or a guaranteed delivery date.

baseline.note: Four reported-before-correction, independently public-source verified WIN records; WIN-004's link to the IRS's edit is temporal only, not proven causal. Total historical wins, not four in the rolling 28-day window.

milestones.name: Fourth verified external correction
milestones.acceptance: A fourth independently verified external implementation documented in WIN-LEDGER.md with original public source, dated after-state, agency/maintainer attribution and limits.
milestones.evidence_scope: IRS 2025 EITC translated numeric corrections verified Nov7, readback Nov22, after Sep18 report; no proof of causal attribution or taxpayer outcomes.

milestones.name: Repeatable low-cost owner-operated case cycle
milestones.acceptance: Two distinct cases moved through primary-source verification, bounded permitted action and independently checked final dispositions, with zero new paid API calls; at least one full case advanced without the founder performing each step.
milestones.blocked_on: Need two distinct owner-independent, zero-new-cash case cycles with verified outside source dispositions; four total WIN records do not prove operational repeatability.
next_steps: Retain OT-003 and OT-013 as two active case cycles; only respond to new material correspondence or due Nov30/Dec2 source checks.
For every case log evidence snapshot, reviewed permitted action, live external disposition, human/independent source check, and cycle time.
Re-use existing hourly coordinator for scheduling; do not require new volunteers or Ollama on a memory-constrained laptop.

milestones.name: Portable Foundry executor with verified safeguards
milestones.acceptance: One genuine model-generated bounded public-safe artifact, independent evidence review, tested authorization/failure/budget ceilings, canonical leases and no duplicate scheduler; a laptop/volunteer must not be required to keep the ordinary case pipeline operating.

acceptance_tests: No model/browser/institutional writes from source packet compilation
Local draft may consume an untrusted candidate packet without treating it as independently verified
A genuine full-model run and provider/lease hard-stop testing still required
development.next_verifiable_result: Test a dedicated database-authenticated least-privileged LOGIN against the existing hosted isolated staging project using an appropriately protected credential and staging-only canonical schema; confirm SESSION_USER identity and negative grants. No paid model call, public RPC, production migration or new scheduled worker.
remaining_blockers: No independently verified full eight-stage live artifact
No verified canonical distributed lease/budget hard-stop for real provider
development.note: Disposable PostgreSQL 17 CI now proves actual password-authenticated TCP executor sessions (3 isolated roles; invalid passwords, role escalation, cross-project, token replay and paid task denial), in addition to prior simulated session switching and hosted staging legacy-token rollback proof. This is NOT an authenticated login on Supabase staging and NOT a real model-provider budget cap.

milestones.name: Cross-border replication
milestones.acceptance: Independently verified outcomes across at least two countries with local-source provenance and reviewed language/context, repeatable without new paid inference accounts.

acceptance_tests: Country ID cannot be swapped between signed-off task and packet
A U.S. bilingual packet requires language competence review
Pakistan numeric-check detects 84/117=71.8 versus displayed 81.6 without alleging a dataset error
All cross-border cases stay pending independent original-source review
development.next_verifiable_result: Preserve source-level trace, obtain institution confirmation or qualified local review, and eventually verify a real implemented Pakistani change; existing 103/117 discrepancy remains uncorrected.
remaining_blockers: No independently confirmed external public correction outside the United States
No qualified Spanish/Urdu language and jurisdiction review
No locally validated G4 operating costs or privacy cross-border compliance
development.note: One verified original-source public HTML acquisition succeeded in Pakistan. Independent domain interpretation and real outside-U.S. public correction remain entirely unproven; existing G4 outcome counter remains zero.

milestones.name: Worldwide sustainable operation
milestones.acceptance: G5-A operational viability: meet end_state.acceptance with qualified review, privacy/deletion controls, uptime and zero unapproved cost. G5-B mature global scale: separately meet maturity_targets with independently auditable measured evidence. Neither submilestone may substitute for the other.

acceptance_tests: Three regions and three reviewed languages
Privacy/deletion, branch integrity, cost cap and incident recovery
development.next_verifiable_result: Obtain one genuine independently operated Tier-0 submission, separate review and optional private Impact Passport pilot record; in parallel resolve only release-critical Foundry, privacy and governance blockers.
remaining_blockers: Regional independent outcomes and measurable 28-day throughput
No accepted independent node or consented Impact Passport pilot
No operational portable badge or institutional recognition agreement
No verified recurring donor baseline or sustained active-node growth
development.note: No G5 acceptance metric has yet been reached.
development.launch_gate: Separate release checkpoint after G4, before broad public launch and mature G5. Explicit owner go decision; blue check required; no G5 completion claim. See ops/mother-launch-readiness.json.

maturity_targets.active_node_definition: Independently operated, consenting, not founder-controlled or duplicate; at least one accepted useful contribution in rolling 28 days. Distinct consenting operators separately counted; no token-registration proxy.
maturity_targets.funding_definition: Distinct verified recurring donors with successful payments in the reporting month; separately report net receipts, refunds, cancellations, cost and runway. No fundraising authorization or assumed tax deduction.
maturity_targets.growth_definition: Report monthly net active-node growth, retention, unique verified external resolutions, review capacity and observed resolution growth rates; claim exponential growth only if longitudinal evidence supports it.

impact_passport.first_milestone: One adult non-owner accepted contribution and private consented record, distinct from downstream outcome and documented human hours.
impact_passport.mature_acceptance: Operational portable verifiable credential with public display off by default, correction/revocation, privacy/deletion, independently checked contribution provenance and anti-gaming; independently verified real participant share and actual institutional recognition agreement.
impact_passport.linkedin: Explore user-controlled credential sharing and a formal partnership or equivalent appropriate credential/social-platform partner; neither platform integration nor partnership claimed without actual acceptance. No partner branding without permission.

maturity_targets.mother: Continuous evidence-backed updates; authorized transparent relevant engagement with leaders; no unsolicited automated replies, impersonation, spam or covert influence.

focus_cases.next_action: Read actual updated bilingual PDF; independently verify lawyer-assignment sentence removal in both languages and document edit date/source. If corrected prepare verified WIN evidence; if unchanged log no change, do not resend routine follow-up.
focus_cases.notes: On Nov 21 PDF still retained both old sentences; Nov 2 agency promised removal; one factual follow-up sent and verified Nov21.

focus_cases.scope: LUMS Punjab school climate-atlas summary count and percentage consistency
focus_cases.next_action: Check 103/117 denominator, 84 percentage, top-five rainfall event dates on live original source. If corrected verify independent before/after and credit CITY; if unchanged do not send second routine follow-up.
focus_cases.notes: Public site still had conflicting 103 vs 117 and 84/117 vs 81.6%, three of five listed events 2025; factual follow-up sent and verified Nov21.

operating_rules.primary_metric: verified case cycle completions with independent external disposition and measured owner effort/cost; WIN-004 already counts historically once, not a new November 22 IRS edit
operating_rules.secondary_metric: completed legitimate source checks and verified external actions, each distinct from outcomes
priority_order: Urgent safety/incident or substantive institutional reply with directly relevant evidence
Due OT-003 or OT-013 public-source recheck tied to active G2 cycle
Within WIP=2, resolve a documented bottleneck in repeatable zero-cost discovery→verification→permitted action→external disposition, with executable or outcome receipt
Only if no due case and a clearly superior official-source opportunity is proven: replace one focus case with explanation and maintain WIP=2
disallowed_as_progress: Only creating plans, tests, diagrams or roles
Unverified LLM messages, social reactions or unscreened volunteer responses
Unanswered email or report sent without verified public change
Stale repeat source checks absent a changed trigger
Automatic model usage without proven hard provider stop and budget
operating_rules.routine_external_contact: No repeat contact after the single dated follow-up for either focus case absent new material evidence or the recipient requesting it.
operating_rules.permission_boundary: Safe read-only checking, evidence capture, public project code fixes and bounded authorized factual replies may proceed without redundant owner re-confirmation. Higher-risk external publication, spending, account creation, new recurring workers, private-data processing and governance changes retain specific existing safeguards.
operating_rules.worker_source: Original enabled Humanity Loop hourly coordinator; do not create a second worker.

parallel_track_policy.selection_rule: When G2 waits on outside action, pursue the next concrete G3/G4/G5 milestone in parallel: independently accepted Foundry artifact, accepted node, consented Passport record, international outcome, or approved funding readiness. Freeze optional engineering refinements; retain safety-critical blockers, WIP=2, no third external case, no claimed accepted outcome without actual independent acceptance, zero new spend, no unsolicited outreach, no new scheduler and sequential release acceptance.
parallel_track_policy.score_readiness_by: Milestone acceptance evidence, not test count or document count; tests are valuable only when tied to a release blocker.
